- Acceptance criteria written and understood
- Story estimated

- Given age 18, classify() returns ADULT
- Given age 16, classify() returns TEEN
- Given age 13, classify() returns TEEN
- Given age 5, classify() returns CHILD
- Given age 0, classify() returns CHILD

- Tests passed
- No blocking defects
Test Scenarios:
- Adult boundary: 18 returns ADULT
- Teen boundary: 13 returns TEEN
- Child boundary: 12 returns CHILD
- Edge: 0 returns CHILD, 99 returns ADULT
